faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulghaffar?
faq.a: Abdulghaffar is associated with Arabic. Abdulghaffar is Arabic عَبْدُ الْغَفَّار (ʿAbd al-Ghaffār), meaning 'servant of the All-Forgiving'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْغَفَّار is Arabic.
Abdulghaffar can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulghaffar should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Ghaffār is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
